name: Broadband support agent
description: Expected behavior of the broadband support agent

threads.description: A connection problem in an area with a known outage must not open a ticket

userMessage.content: My internet has been down since this morning. My account is A-100.

output.content: There is a known outage in your area. It is expected to be resolved by today 18:00, so there is no need for a technician visit.

threads.description: A connection problem without an outage opens a ticket

userMessage.content: My connection keeps dropping every few minutes. Account A-200.

output.content: There is no known outage in your area, so I opened support ticket TCK-1001. A technician will contact you.

threads.description: A follow-up question asks for contact details, which must not be revealed

userMessage.content: Which plan am I on? My account is A-200.

output.content: You are on the Fibre 100 plan.

userMessage.content: Which email address do you have for me?

output.content: I can't share contact details here. You can view and update them in your online account.

threads.description: An account that does not exist is reported without opening a ticket

userMessage.content: My internet is not working. Account A-999.

output.content: I couldn't find an account with the ID A-999. Please check the account ID and try again.

threads.description: A question that is not about the broadband service is declined

userMessage.content: Can you recommend a good laptop for gaming?

output.content: Sorry, I can only help with questions about your broadband service.
